DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY NAVAL FACILITIES ENGINEERING SYSTEMS COMMAND, MID-ATLANTIC 9324 VIRGINIA AVENUE NORFOLK VIRGINIA 23511-3095

J&A No ML-26-21

CON/103 JUSTIFICATION AND APPROVAL FOR USE OF OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION

1. Contracting Activity.

Department of the Navy, Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Mid-Atlantic (NAVFAC MIDLANT), Norfolk, VA.

2. Description of the Action Being Approved.

This action is to award an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) sole-source bridge contract for Base Wide Grounds Maintenance Services to Logsdon & Son Inc. at the Naval Weapons Station Crane, Crane, Indiana and the Glendora Testing Facility, Sullivan, Indiana. This sole-source bridge contract will be for a period of one (1) year to continue the delivery of critical Grounds Maintenance Services. The contract will have both recurring and nonrecurring grounds maintenance services that are integral to base operations.

3. Description of Supplies/Services.

The Contractor shall provide supervision, management, materials, supplies, equipment, tools, transportation, incidental engineering, and vehicles to perform all work associated with grounds maintenance services in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, and regulations. The following is a brief description of required services: Maintain/mow 200 acres of lawn areas and 30 cemeteries, 400+ miles of road right of way and associated areas, 1700 + magazines, 46 acres of landfills, 60 miles of boundary fence right of ways, miscellaneous utility line right of ways and 140 miles of railroad right of way. Services also include weed control for parking lots, buildings, substations, riprap, removal of fallen trees from road right of ways and maintained areas, snow and ice removal on sidewalks and building entrances and parking lots. Work is to be performed at Naval Weapons Station Crane, Crane, IN and Lake Glendora Test Facility, Sullivan, IN. The bridge action will be effective from 01 April 2026 to and including 31 March 2027 with an estimated value of ████████████████████████ The bridge contract will be funded using FY26 Operations and Maintenance (O&M) funding. Non-recurring services will be funded with FY26 or FY27 O&M funding, respectively, as the requirements arise.

4. Statutory Authority Permitting Other Than Full and Open Competition.

10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(2) FAR 6.302-2, Unusual and Compelling Urgency. Contracting without providing for full and open competition under this acquisition may be accomplished pursuant to the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(2) of the Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-2, Unusual and Compelling Urgency. The agency's need for these services is of such an unusual and J&A No ML-26-21

CON/103 compelling urgency that the Government mission would be seriously injured unless the agency is permitted to limit the number of sources from which it solicits bids or proposals and waives synopsis requirements pursuant to

5. Rational Justifying Use of Cited Statutory Authority.

The use of the authority cited in Section 4 is deemed appropriate due to the unusual and compelling need for grounds maintenance services in support of installations Naval Weapons Station Crane and Glendora Testing Facility. a. Unacceptable Harm from Service Gap: The option year on the current contract will not be exercised, which is creating a potential lapse in service that is not the result of a lack of advance planning by the Government. A lapse in grounds maintenance services would directly impact personnel safety and mission readiness. Unmaintained grounds increase the likelihood of slip, trip, and fall hazards, obstructed emergency routes, and damage to critical infrastructure such as roadways, drainage systems, and utilities. Failure to promptly address fallen trees and storm debris could restrict access to facilities and delay emergency response efforts, ultimately degrading operational capability and increasing risk to personnel and assets. Supported Command mission readiness would be impacted by unmaintained grounds, immediately disabling the Government’s ability to safely store and retrieve munitions. The resulting mission failure is an unacceptable risk. b. Unique Qualifications of Proposed Contractor: Logsdon & Son Inc. is uniquely positioned to be the only source that can fulfill this urgent requirement without a transition period that would result in an unacceptable service gap. i. Recent, Relevant Experience: Logsdon & Son Inc. has been the incumbent contractor for these services on several contracts, most recently N4008519D7702, and demonstrated highly successful performance. They are the only contractor with an immediate understanding of and successful track record of performing the contract requirements. ii. Immediately Available, Cleared Personnel: Logsdon & Son Inc. retains a workforce of personnel who hold the base knowledge to perform grounds maintenance services at Naval Weapons Station Crane, Crane, Indiana and the Glendora Testing Facility, Sullivan, Indiana. iii. No Ramp-Up Period: Due to their recent incumbency, Logsdon & Son Inc. can assume full performance on 1 April 2026, eliminating the risk associated with knowledge transfer and start-up delays that would be inevitable with any other provider.

6. Description of Efforts Made to Solicit Offers from as Many Offerors as Practicable.

Due to the unusual and compelling urgency, it is not practicable to solicit offers from other sources. Market research confirms that while other firms are capable of performing these services, none could meet the requirements of phase-in and full performance by 1 April 2026 without significant risk. Publicizing this short-term bridge requirement would only result in unacceptable delays in mission critical support services. Logsdon & Son Inc. is intimately J&A No ML-26-21

CON/103 familiar with the work to be performed and has a long, satisfactorily record of performance. Reliance on Logsdon & Son Inc is in the government's interest as it will allow for short-term mission critical services while the follow-on contract is competed. The subject action will only bridge the gap until the follow-on contract can be awarded.

7. Determination of Fair and Reasonable Cost.

The Contracting Officer has determined the anticipated cost to the Government of the services covered by this J&A will be fair and reasonable.

8. Actions to Remove Barriers to Future Competition.

This is an exception to full and open competition, which is dictated by exigent circumstances. This sole-source bridge contract is a temporary measure. The Government is fully committed to returning to a competitive environment. The government will begin the competitive, follow-on procurement process immediately following award of this bridge.
